page.overview:
Who is King Sadala?

It is said by Cabba that his strong and prideful personality is similar to that of Vegeta's.

King Sadala is mentioned by Cabba at the end of the match between Vegeta and Cabba. After Vegeta discusses the Saiyan pride and how he hopes Cabba will surpass him, Cabba mentions the Saiyan King has a personality similar to his. Vegeta then responds by saying he hopes to meet him one day.

In the manga, Kale and two members of Caulifla's Gang attack a transport carrying jewels and food for King Sadala and manage to get away. Later at their lair it is revealed they stole the food to give to poor Saiyan children, before Cabba arrives to recruit Caulifla to take part in the Tournament of Power.

King Sadala is mentioned again during the middle of the Tournament of Power, when Vegeta reveals to Cabba that he'll wish for Universe 6 to be resurrected if he wins, knowing that only one Universe will survive, and he still wants to meet the king.
